notes.title: 《妙连千军》更新日志 6月17日
notes.notes:
说在最前
欢迎大家加入QQ群：724304617
这里有划水陪聊的制作团队
还有积极提供攻略的大佬们~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021705/f6323298d2299c68353018ddc6af0f38da3ace9d.png[/img]


正文开始了
自妙连千军发售已经过去了6天的时间
所有评价我们都有看
也会尽力做到每一条都去回复

针对大部分人反馈的简单到普通难度跨度过大的问题
我们尽快进行了一波调整
在经过QA部门的一轮测试后，于今天更新了

更新内容如下：

[h3]普通难度也可以复活一次[/h3]
[h3]普通难度降低难度[/h3]
  - 敌人-雪山巨人：冰冻棋子数量下调2->1
  - 敌人-雪山巨人：血量下调800->600
  - 敌人-火山剑士：血量下调3000->2500,攻击下调300->200
  - 敌人-火山火球：行动速度变缓 4->5
  - 敌人-岩浆巨人：血量下调600->400
  - 敌人-焦油史莱姆：血量下调250->150
  - 敌人-火焰巨龙：行动速度变缓 2->4
  - 敌人-冰龙：攻击下调550->500
  - 敌人-尖刺仙人掌：反伤攻击下调 30->20
  - 敌人-剧毒水母：血量下调100->75
  - 敌人-生气的火山三兄弟：行动速度变缓（+1），血量下调（-1000）
  - 敌人-僵尸将军：血量下调1000->500,行动速度变缓 3->4
  - 敌人-龙卷风：血量下调6000->5000

[h3]初始三位英雄强化[/h3]
  - 大骑士：护盾提高400->500，血量提高HP700->800
  - 大骑士：2技能耗魔减少50
  - 精灵射手：血量提高HP800->900
  - 骷髅武士：血量提高HP1200->1350
[h3]其他[/h3]
 - 优化漫画效果
 - 优化超宽屏情况下的适配和一些适配bug
 - 修复集火会锁定空白处的bug
 - 修复战斗中棋子稍稍偏移的bug

最后打个小广告
妙连千军玩家征集活动也开始了哦
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1021800/announcements/detail/2381789144751128676]感兴趣的可以点击查看~[/url]

别急别急
再来最后一句，有一些玩家认为
简单模式不能玩到所有游戏内容以及简单通关弹框提示问题

首先绝对不是觉得简单模式不配玩完所有内容
由于简单模式其实类似新手教程且确实比较简单
玩家简单模式玩太久会逐渐失去兴趣
所以将内容缩短为了比较快速就能玩完的内容

EA版本简单通关的提示本身是没有的
因为有些玩家简单通关后以为这就是全部内容
因为这个原因得到了不少误解
所以增加了现在的提示~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021705/ec3a0e28c9c821fa4e474766ac12e48b52d51a7d.jpg[/img]

好了，真的结束了~
预祝大家通关顺利！！奥利给！

notes.notes:

  - Ice Dragon: Random long-range attack, which can freeze enemies during the five eliminations. (Similar to dizziness, but the injury is halved)
  - Demon Flower: Melee attack, which increases the number of abnormal rounds on the enemy when hit.

notes.title: Price adjustment
notes.notes:
Hello brave adventurers
Before the official announcement
We still have to say thanks to everyone
Thank you friends for your attention and support during this time

In the two months since the game's preemptive demo version
We have received countless suggestions and opinions
Although this is the first time to make a Steam game
But it ’s everybody who writes a review seriously
Let us never lose the courage to go all the way

In these two months
We have updated a lot of heroes and plots
And optimized many bugs with your help

As products become more sophisticated
We recently adjusted the price of the game

In addition to subsistence
Another important reason for the price increase is
We will officially release the game in the near future
In order to bring everyone a first-time discount
So you must increase the price at least 30 days in advance

Specific release date
We will tell you as soon as we are sure
Please also be patient

notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
It's been almost a week since the game was released
During this week, we all saw and responded to all the comments.

There are serious suggestions to encourage us to continue to cheer
There are also players who have a lot of questions because the game experience is not good ~
Because there are many problems, we have prioritized them and deal with them one by one.
I also hope everyone will be patient and wait patiently

At present, it mainly focuses on the bug that the game will be stuck at the end of the battle, and the game value is not balanced.
Next, the game experience will be optimized.
For example,Added combat records during the battle, improved skills description, etc. 

Updates have been released this week to optimize the game

  - In the title screen setting page, you can choose to give up the progress, which can be used 
    to restart the game when the player saves the archive without deleting the archive manually.

[h3]BUG[/h3]
  - Players are not allowed to perform special actions when enemies perform special actions
  - Attempted to fix the problem that the battle could not end after destroying all the enemies
  - Fixed a bug where the Royal Purchasing Certificate would cause two identical relics to 
     appear in the store
  - Fix the function of reading files for some players who have been corrupted

[h3]Balance adjustment[/h3]
  - Relics-Merchant’s Soul: Reduced money ratio (350%-> 200%)
  -Relics-Thief’s Mask: Price reduction (5000-> 3000)
  -Relic-The  Ascetic     The  Ascetic     : Increased critical strike rate (50%-> 100)
  -Relic-CPU: Hit number of auto-shooting is reduced (2-> 1)
  -Relics-Insomnia: Days Adjustment (5-> 3)
  -Relic-Alarm: Increased damage reduction multiplier (75%-> 90%)
  -Relic-Full  Platemail: Reduced speed (50%-> 65%)
  -Relics-The +1: Price increase (5k-> 7k)
  -Relics-Bat Hat: Reduced blood-sucking ratio (15% -10%)
  -RelicsDamaged Pocketwatch: Maximum number of days increased (5-> 6)
  -Relics-VIP Card: Price reduction (3500-> 2500)
  -Units-Robotic Crossbow: Removed extra critical strike attributes
  -Units-The  obsidian statue : Reduced recovery per turn to 3 | 6 | 9 | 12
  -Enemy-Porthos、Athos、Aramis: Removed extra critical multiplier and increased health in angry state
  -Weak: Weakness adjusted to 30% | 50% | 70%

notes.title: Million Dungeon Changelog 2020/3/16
notes.notes:
[h3]BUG[/h3]
  - Fixed the wrong performance when the three relics are equipped with Mask of the 
    Manspider andSkunk Headgear and The +1
  - Fixed an issue where the upgrade button was often not clicked on the training ground 
    interface
  - Fix the issue that the Chameleon upgrade preview information is incorrect
  - Fixed the issue where the shield can be fully re-entered when exiting the game during 
    Terran Hero Battle
  - Fixed an issue where the Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy could not trigger 
    passive effects of other five elimination relics

[h3]Relic adjustment[/h3]
  - Lots of relics added to the store
  - Relics-Bag of Avarice: Increased Money Ratio (25%-> 40%)
  - Relic-Doom Curse: Reduced bonus damage ratio (150%-> 75%)
  - Relic-Doom Punisher: Reduced additional critical strike rate (50%> 25%)
  - Relics-Doom Roulette: Decrease in number of rounds (3-> 2)
  - Relic-Frost Dagger: Reduced critical strike damage (500%-> 200%)
  - Relic-Comfy Pillow: Additional effect increased (50%-> 75%)
  - Relic-Gold Coin Armor: Increased damage reduction (50%-> 80%)
  - Relic-Mystic Telescope: Increased damage ratio (25%-> 50%)
  - Relic-Pride: Reduced damage ratio (400%-> 250%)
  - Relics-Bat Hat: Reduced Vampiric Ratio (20%-> 15%)
  - Relics-Angelic Blessing : HP bonus lowered (500-> 400) and blood return rate lowered 
      (100%-> 50%)
  - Relic-Call to Arms: Initial inspiration level increased (1-> 2)
  - Relic-Ring of Shields: Guardian's continuous rounds are increased (2-> 5)
  - Relic-Blast Knuckles, Infected Knuckles: Increased damage ratio (50%-> 100%)
  - Relics-Pandora’s Box: Gold rewards increased by 10 times
  - Relic-The Compass: Damage rate increased (100%-> 150%)
  - Relic-Blood of the Berserker: Damage ratio reduced (150%-> 75%)
  - Relics-Wood Spirit’s Quiver: Price reduction (13k-> 7k), remote hit number reduction (2-> 
    1)
  - Relic-Mind’s Eye: The critical strike rate is lowered again (33%-> 25%), and the price is 
    increased (5k-> 8k)
  - Relic-Piano: Increased damage ratio (200%-> 400%)
  - Relics-High Interest Loan: gains of gold coins increased (10k-> 30k), and the ratio of gold 
    coins changed (50%-> 75%)
  - Relics-Artistic Book, Book of Skill: Upgrades increased (1-> 2)

[h3]Enemy  adjustment[/h3]
  - Zombie Soldier, Zombie Captain,Assault zombie soldier, no longer immune to poison
  - The Dragon Egg's health has been increased, and the hatching speed has been increased     
    by 1 round on Simple and Normal difficulty.
  - Lava Colossus attack speed increased by 1 round
  - Increasing health of Snow Mountain World
  - Tundra Wolf and Snowberg Gaint attack speed increased by 1 turn
  - Raid Pirate attack speed increased by 1 round

[h3]Hero skill adjustment[/h3]
  -Soul General: 1 skill cut mana cost reduced by 25
  -Void Elf: 1 skill CD reduced (6-> 5), 2 skill CD changed from fixed 10 to 10-> 15
[h3]There are some things that have been changed but forgot to record[/h3]
